implementation.targetScope: JSON reading/writing with callback, Promise and synchronous APIs plus the utils formatter used by fs-extra. Verified through unchanged Capacitor config and plugin metadata callers. Native fs and JSON; no package dependencies.

differences: Injected filesystem methods retain their receiver.
Custom EOL strings are literal rather than JavaScript replacement-string programs.
Frozen reviver errors retain identity; byte-view BOM input is supported.
Native filesystem errors are surfaced without graceful-fs global patches or descriptor-exhaustion queueing.
No public release or application adoption claimed.
